title: Do not ratify a train-bearing plan whose interlocking sanity fails

facts.note: Fires during the CONFIRM/ratify phase of a plan session (validation.phase).
The ratify/lock action on a plan session is the trigger.

values: plan session carries one or more trains
facts.note: Needs an observer that knows the session is train-bearing and reports interlocking sanity results per train/interlocking/route.

fires: Planner ratifies a train-bearing plan session at CONFIRM, and a required interlocking sanity check for one of its routes fails.
At CONFIRM, a ratify attempt on a train-bearing plan session would lock it while a required interlocking sanity rule is reported failing.
doesNotFire: Plan session carries no train (not train-bearing).
All required interlocking sanity checks pass at ratify time.
Planning work before the CONFIRM phase that does not attempt to ratify or lock the session.

given: A train-bearing plan session at the CONFIRM phase where a required interlocking sanity check fails
when: The planner attempts to ratify (lock) the plan
then: Ratify must refuse to lock the plan, leaving the session unlocked.
prefer: Read the failed rule for the reported train, interlocking and route, fix the plan's interlocking, and re-run ratify.
avoid: Marking the session locked/confirmed, even partially, while it is train-bearing and a required interlocking sanity check fails.
Making sanity pass by dropping the train or its routes from the plan instead of fixing the interlocking.
why: Locking a train-bearing plan whose interlocking is unsound would ratify routes that cannot run safely; confirm is the last gate before the plan is fixed.
evidence: On a failing ratify, the session remains unlocked and the failure report includes session_id, train_id, interlocking_id, route_id and failed_rule.
verifier_detail: phase=CONFIRM; enforcement=confirm-blocking (a failure blocks ratify); subject_kind=plan-session.
Required failure evidence fields: session_id, train_id, interlocking_id, route_id, failed_rule.
